source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both thirds, all grass and the repeated burning without harmonizing the quantities.
key_decisions.before: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and these were thrown upon the earth. And a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
key_decisions.after: The first sounded his trumpet. Hail and fire mixed with blood came and were thrown to the earth. A third of the earth burned, a third of the trees burned, and all the green grass burned.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and these were thrown upon the earth. And a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows eagle rather than angel and keeps the triple woe and remaining three.
key_decisions.before: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew in midheaven, “Woe, woe, woe to the earth’s inhabitants, at the blasts of the remaining trumpets that the three angels are about to sound!”
key_decisions.after: I looked and heard an eagle flying high overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe, woe, woe to those who live on the earth, because of the remaining trumpet blasts of the three angels who are about to sound them!”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle crying with a loud voice as it flew in midheaven, “Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, at the blasts of the remaining trumpets that the three angels are about to sound!”
